brief.prompt: A smartphone mounted on a small tripod stand at eye height on a tidy wooden desk next to a window, its screen dark, with an empty chair facing it. Soft morning light fills a minimalist room.
brief.alt: Phone on a tripod set up at eye level by a window for consistent face rating photos
brief.purpose: Demonstrates recreating the same camera position, distance and light for every retest, so score changes reflect real changes rather than setup.

review.alt: A smartphone with a dark screen on a small black tripod sits on a wooden desk beside a sunlit window, facing an empty upholstered chair, in a bright minimalist room with a plant, mug, books and pencil cup.
